title: KATSEYE Expands Wildworld Tour With 2027 Dates In Asia, Australia
summary: The international girl group’s Wildworld Tour expands with the addition of 11 new shows next year across Asia, Australia and New Zealand.
contentText:
EYEKONS, there’s more KATSEYE to come.

The international girl group’s Wildworld Tour expands with the addition of 11 new shows across Asia, Australia and New Zealand early next year. 

Promoted by Live Nation, the new leg will get underway Jan. 27 at Yokohama Arena in Yokohama, Japan, then heads to Manila, Hong Kong, Seoul, Cebu, Singapore, Bangkok and Taipei. Following a 10-day break, the group returns to Australia for concerts in Sydney and Melbourne before wrapping things up March 5 at Auckland’s Spark Arena.

KATSEYE are making good on their promise of a prompt return to Australia . The two-time Grammy Award-nominated pop act made a whistlestop trip to these parts earlier in the year, where the singers participated in an exclusive fan Q&A experience and an industry showcase in Sydney, then performed for superfans in Melbourne. Bandmate Lara Raj went on to tell Australia’s Nova network “we love it here,” and “it would make us very happy to come back and spend a lot of time here.”

There’s no confirmation, however, on what the lineup will look like for those new shows. Specifically, if Sophia Laforteza would be back with the band.

Earlier this month, the group’s label, HYBE x Geffen, stated that Laforteza would return to the stage in January , which would be sweet timing for the Asia run.  

Then, at the 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show, Lara Raj, Megan Skiendiel, Yoonchae Jeong and Daniela Avanzini gave the first timeline for Laforteza’s return from a temporary hiatus . The label announced Laforteza’s break in April to allow the singer to focus on her mental health and wellness.

KATSEYE are in the midst of their first-ever arena tour of North America. Those dates are in support of WILD (HYBE x Geffen Records), which blasted to No. 1 on the Billboard 200 in August for the group’s first leader. WILD was the followup to 2025’s Beautiful Chaos , which peaked at No. 4 on the all-genres albums survey.

The general onsale for next year’s concerts in Asia, Australia and New Zealand begins Friday, Nov. 6 at 2pm local time at katseye.world . In the meantime, the documentary KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is now streaming on Disney+ and Hulu in the United States and Disney+ internationally.
